item.tib: sangs rgyas dang g.yung drung sems dpa'i tshogs nyi shu pa'i rab gnas ud pal 'od ldan rgyan gyi phreng ba
item.coloph: sangs rgyas dang g.yung drung sems dpa' nyi shu pa'i rab tu gnas pa'i bde ba'i yan lag tu ston pa ud pal 'od ldan rgyan gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba/ rgyud sde rin chen gzungs kyi las tshogs brgyad bcu las byung ba/ dmu rgyal rnal 'byor nyi ma'i ming can gyis/ ngo mtshar che ba'i ri mor bris pa dge legs 'phel//
